message.content: {"criteria":[{"id":"C1","level":"Accomplished","mark":8,"evidence":[{"where":"Introduction","quote":"Coral reefs, specifically the Great Barrier Reef, would immensely benefit from dedicated satellite monitoring."},{"where":"Introduction","quote":"Thus, only one satellite is required."},{"where":"Introduction","quote":"The proposed satellite would likely be used by governmental and science agencies (e.g. CSIRO, BOM)"}],"reasoning":"Mission purpose, rationale, single-spacecraft justification and users are all addressed with literature support. Rationale is persuasive; operator/customer distinction is somewhat loose but adequate for high standard."},{"id":"C2","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Orbit","quote":"an altitude of 600km requires a mean inclination of 97.7924°"},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","quote":"An average contact duration of almost ten minutes was achieved"},{"where":"Mission Duration & EOL","quote":"The proposed ZYZZsat is small and without thrusters in a low-earth orbit."}],"reasoning":"All major elements covered with STK screenshots and access data. But launch choice is speculative (Vega E not yet built), RAAN justification is weak, no link budget or hand calculations, and EOL text is truncated. Errors and thin evidence keep it at adequate."},{"id":"C3","level":"Adequate","mark":6,"evidence":[{"where":"Conclusion","quote":"A specific launch vehicle – the Vega E – has been selected although it has not been built yet."}],"reasoning":"Conclusion summarises the design and acknowledges launch risk, but is largely a restatement of sections with little quantitative synthesis or specific recommendation."},{"id":"C4","level":"Adequate","mark":5,"evidence":[{"where":"Orbit","quote":"STK 3D view of orbit: 12 hours apart"},{"where":"Bibliography","quote":"[10 d."}],"reasoning":"Structure and headings are clear, but figures lack numbered captions, references are bare URLs with a Wikipedia source, and there are typos and a broken reference. Writing is readable but not professional."}],"requirements":[{"id":"R1","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R2","met":"yes","where":"Mission Design"},{"id":"R3","met":"yes","where":"Executive Summary"},{"id":"R4","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R5","met":"yes","where":"Introduction"},{"id":"R6","met":"yes","where":"Launch"},{"id":"R7","met":"yes","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R8","met":"partial","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R9","met":"yes","where":"Ground Control & Communications"},{"id":"R10","met":"yes","where":"Mission Duration & EOL"},{"id":"R11","met":"partial","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R12","met":"partial","where":"Ground Control & Communications"},{"id":"R13","met":"yes","where":"Contents"},{"id":"R14","met":"no","where":"Orbit"},{"id":"R15","met":"partial","where":"Bibliography"}],"technical_issues":[{"where":"Orbit","issue":"RAAN of 27.33° is claimed to indicate launch site location; RAAN is not determined by launch site alone and this is not justified."},{"where":"Orbit","issue":"No hand calculation shown for the sun-synchronous inclination; only a plot is given."},{"where":"Ground Control & Communications","issue":"No link budget or data-rate analysis to support 'sufficient' contact duration."},{"where":"Mission Duration & EOL","issue":"EOL paragraph is truncated/incomplete; drag sail described but no sizing or deorbit time estimate."},{"where":"Launch","issue":"Selects Vega E, which is not yet operational, and relies on a Wikipedia timeline for launch options."},{"where":"Orbit","issue":"Swath/altitude trade-off asserted qualitatively without resolution or sensor parameters."}],"overall":"A coherent, well-structured mission concept covering all required elements with STK evidence, but weakened by speculative launch choice, missing quantitative calculations, incomplete EOL discussion, poor figure labelling and referencing."}
